verdict.rationale: Composio docs describe a general 'provider' adapter concept that turns Composio tools into the native format for a target framework (composio-docs-12), implying multi-framework support, and it also exposes MCP and CLI integration paths (composio-docs-4, composio-docs-10, composio-probe-3/4). However, the evidence pack never names or documents adapters for the specific frameworks in the story (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs), so the breadth and quality of per-framework documentation can't be confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documented adapter pages/examples for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, and OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, plus any independent confirmation these integrations work in practice.
